review.official:
Member of the
Yan
disaster relief organization "Chun-qian," primarily carrying out relief efforts in some colder regions of Yan prone to
Catastrophe
. After enrolling in Chun-qian's exchange project with
Rhodes Island
, was selected for her outstanding application, and accepted dispatch to Rhodes Island to study Oripathy and relevant aid knowledge. Outside of study, also serves as an interim operator assisting the Medical Department.

files.description:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7%
Slight visible Originium crystallization around lower torso.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.22u/L
Operator Mulberry situates for long periods in danger regions with high risk of infection. In spite of a relatively strong protective awareness and excellent grasp of treatment skills, she still requires regular examination to avoid her condition worsening.

Rhodes Island's exchange and study program with relief organization 'Chun-qian' is a new project, with Rhodes Island principally offering anti-Oripathy protective methods in emergency situations, as well as focused treatment measures for the onset stage and other such subjects—these studies are a specialty of Rhodes Island, while also being essential for Catastrophe relief crew.
Having been passed stringent tests and selection processes, there's no cause to doubt Mulberry's ability in her specialty field.

On first arrival at Rhodes Island, Mulberry's behavior was a cause for concern. She was reserved with words, shy and timid, carrying books as she went about on her own. Though she had fine marks on her language tests, she was incapable of smoothly starting and holding conversations with other operators.
This was no small issue, but fortunately, some Rhodes Island operators from Yan quickly picked up on the circumstances of this new girl—people from Yan always tend to be extremely close with others from the same region, and with everyone's encouragement, Mulberry finally took her first step, working up the courage to chat with a few Catastrophe Messengers staying at Rhodes Island.
And so long as a window for communication is left open, there's no need to worry.

Born to a traditional family in Jiangqi City, Yan, Mulberry was the youngest girl of her generation in the household. Her academic record at school was considered above average; despite her intense efforts studying, she was never able to rank at the top. She felt a sense of dejection and disappointment, her character growing increasingly introverted alongside.
Whether in her teachers' or her family's eyes, the earnest, hard-working, clever and amenable Mulberry was a sweetheart who put others at ease. Not too individualistic, not quite outstanding, but meek, untroublesome, didn't overstep her bounds—the picture of a good child.
Mulberry's mother and father long had plans for their daughter's future; they hoped Mulberry would receive a sound and fine education, then find a safe, stable job, and live what, to an ordinary person, would be a calm and fulfilled life. But against everyone's expectations, the obedient-since-birth, rarely self-expressive Mulberry went against the norm. She didn't heed her family's arrangements, but instead, following her graduation, delivered her resume to 'Chun-qian' without telling her family, and went far away from home.
As one would imagine, this unprecedented rebelliousness of hers caused a huge commotion in her family. But just as Mulberry had written in her farewell letter to her parents, ever since witnessing the tragedy of a Catastrophe in her youth, she had secretly fostered her own ambitions, and only in this regard was she unwilling to defer to her elders' plans.
The girl summoned the greatest courage of her life, and set out to decide her future for herself.

Mulberry is very reserved, to the point of almost cowardice. When going to bed at night, if she isn't hugging an old doll from home, she'll be unable to fall asleep. And it's because of her anxiety that she always has, purportedly very effective, protective charms hung all over her personal belongings. At most times, the impression she gives is introverted, timid, careful and cautious, gentle yet frail. But when involved her field of specialty, Mulberry will temporarily throw off all cowardice and hesitation. At these times, as a relief worker, for the sake of those she's saving, she has to become reliable.
The resolve and self-confidence Mulberry displays during her work can surprise any operator working with her for the first time.

Mulberry's parents' expectations were for her to have a smooth and steady life, but with her Oripathy infection, such expectations are now wild dreams.
Perhaps, when leaving home, Mulberry felt discontent with her family's plans, and rebelled against their control. But after joining the relief squad, after wrapping herself in a standard sleeping bag and knowing the sensation of her extremities frozen numb; listening to the gale outside her tent, alone, too scared to even sleep the whole night; at the height of the wind's howls, furtively shrinking out of homesickness into her sleeping bag to weep, letting the sound of the wind cover her own sobs... after going through all that, her varieties of discontent, of complaints and rebellion, all dissipated into unimportance.
But happily, in her second year with the squad, Mulberry—gradually accustomed to the arduous work life—restored normal relations bit by bit with her family. One time while on her way to visit home, Mulberry witnessed her father, who had been so vehemently opposed to her joining a relief organization, holding a letter she'd sent, standing at the corner of his street, mentioning her name to the neighbors.
'This is work that saves people! Our girl's not scared of a hard time. Good on her!'
That proud look never shown to her before, spread across her ever-strict father's face, is a sight Mulberry reckons she'll remember forever.

Everyone knows what a disaster relief worker faces after a Catastrophe.
Before she made the decision to leave home, Mulberry already understood that choosing to be a relief worker is to choose an inevitably trying, challenging way of life. Many disasters... especially Catastrophes that induce serious Originium calamity, not only gravely impact the lives of those who live in the disaster zone. Those who head in to make the rescue are also enduring one rigorous trial after another.
No matter how strictly you prepare gear in advance, things can slip through the cracks. Active year-round in Catastrophe zones, rescuing those affected, there are times workers even face a sudden second disaster. In a profession as hazardous as a relief worker's, Oripathy infection is very hard to avoid.
The moment you choose this line of work, you've already chosen to set own your safety aside.
Of course, this much is true for Mulberry.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, I'll leave the files I sorted here. Oh, you don't have to thank me. I am used to it, and it's nothing difficult... Um, are you thirsty perhaps? Should I make you some tea?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I'm not very good at speaking any languages other than Yanese. That's why I was a little scared at first and didn't talk much. But everyone's very friendly, and there are a lot of people from Yan here. Phew... it really puts my mind at ease.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Sorry to disturb you, Doctor, but would you happen to know where Provence and everyone else went? My family sent me some goodies from back home, and I thought I'd share some with them since they've been taking care of me... Oh, there are some for you too, Doctor. Please have a taste!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, could you help me look for my little dumpling? It's the small black-and-white doll. I thought I'd left it here, but I can't find it... *Whimpers*, please, I can't sleep at night without it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The rescue team has to deal with the Catastrophes a lot, so it's only a matter of time for us before we become infected. None of us reject anyone because of that. The crystallization on my body isn't very conspicuous, and it doesn't hurt even if you press down on it... Sometimes, I even forget that I have this on my body.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: When I first joined the rescue team, I wasn't very used to the climate or the food there. I'd get too homesick to fall asleep at night, and I cried to myself many, many times, but whenever I see the people we rescued, I start to think that maybe I can keep at it...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, sorry to bother you... I've been studying Oripathy prevention techniques during Catastrophe relief, and Tsukinogi suggested that I come ask for your advice... Um... Sorry, am I being a bother?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Uhh! Doctor, why would you sneak up on me like that? Huh? What am I holding? Oh, this is a letter I got from home. When I made the decision to leave, my parents were so angry that they said they would disown me, but there's a saying where I come from: Blood is thicker than water...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: When I got infected with Oripathy, I knew I probably wouldn't be able to live the peaceful life my parents wanted for me. I don't regret it, though... Besides, if I hadn't made my decision, I would never have met you or anyone else from Rhodes Island here and now, hehe.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? Doctor? Sorry to bother you. Please lift your head up a little and sleep with the cushion. If you fall asleep like this, the letters from the report will get all over your face...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm a member of the Yan disaster relief organization 'Chun-qian,' dispatched here as an intern. My name is... Oh, I-I'm sorry. We need to use our codenames here, right? I'm terribly, terribly sorry. Please call me Mulberry.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Uhh..The mountain collapsed, and the ground crumbled...! They're not special effects from an action movie, are they?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Huh? A promotion? Really? I get a salary from Rhodes Island as well as Chun-qian?! I... I'm so happy...!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This time, I'm not doing this to help someone else, I'm doing it for myself... Doctor, thanks for always being there to cheer me on. Now, I'm sure that everything that I've done is truly meaningful.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll do my best to support everyone!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Huh? Me as team captain? Ah... Are you sure?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Okay, we'll head out right away... Everyone, please stay safe. We'll meet again once this is over.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Watch out, everyone! There's movement up ahead!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Safety goggles... Okay, I have mine on. Let's go!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Phew... Haah! Oh, I'm here! I-I'm not nervous!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Preparing rescue...!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Rescue team Mulberry in position!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Everyone, please be careful!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I... I can do it too!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Where are you looking? It's dangerous to get distracted!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: It's my job to ensure everyone's safety!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Report! All rescue operations in the area have been completed. Evacuation and escort proceeding without issue! Phew, thank goodness nobody's hurt...

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew, that wraps up the operation. Doctor, was I helpful?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Wait! It's not safe that way... We have to do something. I'll go fetch them right away!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's not safe here! Everyone, please evacuate! Doctor, follow me!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Whoa, this is the staff dormitory... Um, will I need to pay rent?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh? Ah! I'm sorry! I'm sorry!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor! I really appreciate it, but please stop trying to sneak any more amulets onto me... I have way too many already!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I didn't expect to spend the New Year here at Rhodes Island. It feels...fresh. Actually, it's been a few years since I've been home for the New Years because of work. I really want to go back, even if I can only see my home from far away...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. Do you have work today too?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday... I'd like to ask, ever since I gave you that amulet, did any of your wishes happen to come true...? N—No? Then... do you have any wishes for your birthday, that I can make real?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: So many doctors aboard Rhodes Island are Infected themselves. Rescue workers who can't protect themselves properly... they're not a rare sight to see. But these rescuers still choose to walk towards disaster, realizing the risk and taking it in. Their conviction is most precious. I hope that our effort can help more people live in peace.
